findings.scenario: A viewer submits through chat and buttons, reconnects, then replays a prior-turn command.
findings.gap: Eligibility identity, cross-channel deduplication and idempotency retention are undefined.
findings.recommendation: Bind server-issued identity, match, turn and action ID; atomically consume one influence unit across channels and reject stale epochs. Specify reconnect and retention rules.

findings.scenario: Chat instructs the model to grant authority; its otherwise valid proposal arrives after resolution starts.
findings.gap: Schema validation alone does not bind proposal authority, deadline or original intent.
findings.recommendation: Treat chat as untrusted data; allowlist commands and arguments, bind proposals to immutable viewer/turn provenance, enforce server arrival deadlines and discard late completions without transferring influence.

findings.scenario: An operator receives a modified or replayed data-only hotfix manifest.
findings.gap: Trusted approver, artifact authenticity and anti-rollback contracts are unspecified.
findings.recommendation: Require explicit approval, pinned artifact hash and authenticated signer; bind version, base-state/rules hash and expiry. Reject unknown DSL capabilities and activate atomically at a declared boundary.

findings.scenario: Bot backfill is relabeled human during reconnect or recovery and contributes bounty.
findings.gap: Visible bot labels do not establish durable reward provenance.
findings.recommendation: Persist immutable actor origin and eligibility snapshots in an authoritative contribution ledger; exclude synthetic events from bounty creation and reward allocation, including after recovery.

findings.scenario: Offline failover occurs while an action or reward is committed; recovery replays it.
findings.gap: Atomic handover, single-writer authority and reconciliation rules are absent.
findings.recommendation: Specify epoch fencing, checkpoint plus accepted-command ledger, atomic mode switch and exactly-once effect/reward application. Freeze ambiguous commits for reconciliation; label fixture/live provenance separately.
